sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production art for the approved clean comic medieval fantasy mobile game. Input image 1 is STYLE reference only: match crisp dark espresso outlines, chunky deliberately designed shapes, two or three distinct hard-edged cel shaded values and restrained broad highlights. Readable at small game size, consistent hand drawn contour, limited detail, warm ochre accents. No photorealism, airbrush gradients, plastic shine, bloom, microtexture, excessive ornament, text, typography, watermark or UI screenshot. Asset type: ONE square upper-screen hero staging background, no characters and no interface. A quiet royal guild training alcove, camera almost frontal with a modest downward view of the floor, not an overhead map. Composition must support a separate full-body character in the LEFT half: low circular warm sandstone standing dais, its oval top surface centered at precisely about 30% of canvas width and 86% of canvas height, broad enough for both boots and a stance, visible elliptical top and short 8cm front riser. Clear gently shaded flat floor around it. A simple muted sage-slate wall behind, broad quiet shaded plaster in the upper 70%, a shallow rounded arch and a few distant timber details at outer edges. A couple of small shields at far right only. The RIGHT half is especially quiet uncluttered medium gray sage wall/floor for separate gear controls. A restrained side light from upper left with modest drawn contact shadows. The dais should feel like a functional standing area not a ceremonial altar, clean top, no runes, no flames, no glow, no fantasy particles. Interior palette muted sage gray, pale warm stone, oak brown, small navy accents. Keep wall/floor perspective believable and readable, frame the complete dais with margin, don't crop it. No gigantic weapons in front, no flag crossing the character position, no large window, no sky, no sun rays, no extreme perspective, no throne, no inventory or backpack region. This is only the upper illustrated environment; lower inventory will be plain code-rendered paper.

edit.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this generated clean comic fantasy hero-stage environment. Preserve the crisp outlined, restrained cel-shaded sage wall and warm sandstone palette, quiet guild training room and overall atmosphere. Make ONLY the composition and dais changes needed for portrait upper-screen use: output PORTRAIT 3:4 canvas; substantially extend the quiet plain upper wall, scale the circular standing dais DOWN so its complete oval top is only about 34% of canvas width, and move its top-surface center to x=30% of canvas width, y=89% of canvas height. The whole dais including short riser and shadow must fit without cropping with 10% clear side margin; do not enlarge the dais to fill the foreground. Keep a broad plain sage plaster wall behind a separately rendered hero and controls, extend floor enough to surround the small dais. The standing dais remains a low round sandstone step with a clear oval top and short front riser. Sparse edge timber and stone details only; remove the long blue banner on the left, remove large foreground weapons, barrels and furniture. RIGHT half stays a quiet sage wall. No character, no interface, no text, no windows, no sky, no rays, no bloom or blur, no new decorative objects. Preserve the intentionally simple painted game art.
